 Minnesota takes on Chicago, aims for 5th straight home win 
 Minnesota looks to prolong its four-game home win streak with a victory over Chicago 
 By The Associated Press November 14, 2026, 2:03 AM 
 1:30 Chicago Bulls (2-9, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (9-3, fifth in the Western Conference)
 Minneapolis; Saturday, 8 p.m. EST
 LINE: Timberwolves -13.5; over/under is 236.5
 BOTTOM LINE: Minnesota hosts Chicago trying to continue its four-game home winning streak.
 Minnesota went 49-33 overall with a 26-15 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Timberwolves averaged 118.0 points per game last season, 50.3 in the paint, 18.3 off of turnovers and 16.0 on fast breaks.
 Chicago went 31-51 overall, 19-32 in Eastern Conference games and 13-28 on the road a season ago. The Bulls allowed opponents to score 121.5 points per game and shoot 47.8% from the field last season.
